kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
يحتضرون (form VIII)
# يَحْتَضِرُونَ (yaḥtaḍirūna) /jaħ.ta.dˤi.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara)
# يُحْتَضَرُونَ (yuḥtaḍarūna) /juħ.ta.dˤa.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara) and اُحْتُضِرَ (uḥtuḍira)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
